Case reference: 2008000799.CaseDesc: On August 26th, 1986 Terry Field and Linda Blackwell left Lost Nation Airport, east of Cleveland, Ohio en route to Brantford Municipal Airport, Brantford, Ontario. The pilot was advised to turn west, then Air Traffic Control lost radio and radar contact with the plane. Debris from the plane was located on August 27, 1986 in Lake Erie, approximately 32 nautical miles south of the St.Thomas Airport. Debris was drifting in a southeast direction and was recovered approximately 1-3 nautical miles on the Canadian side of the international boundary line in Lake Erie. Debris was identified by Bud Field,  brother of Terry Field, as having come from the missing aircraft.

Case reference: 2014002821.CaseDesc: On the weekend of August 18, 1972, Dennis Simpson and a friend went fishing on McMillian Lake in Manitoba. They told the person that they were going to make one more pass and then break camp. The weather conditions at the time were such that there would have been rough water. Given this, and the fact that the men were in a relatively small canoe, it was determined that they may have capsized. An extensive search by land, water and air failed to find anything other than various items identified as belonging to the two missing fishermen. Dennis was never found.

It was learned that the subject checked into the hotel under the name "CHERON, Deoung".  A small black bag containing herbal medication was located in the room, which after translation from Korean revealed the prescription was issued to "PARK, Seng Dae"(variation of spelling PARK, Sang Dae).  It should be noted that the bus ticket-stub was located with the deceased identified "DUNG" as the individual who purchased the ticket.
Numerous checks were made with variety of agencies in an attempt to determine the man's identity.  It is believed he may be of Korean or Chinese decent.

Case reference: 2014005499.CaseDesc: During the early morning hours of Friday, October 1st, 2010, Janice Cher Desjarlais and her boyfriend crawled into a dumpster located behind The Center of Hope on Franklin Avenue in Fort McMurray. Janice's boyfriend advised that he left at approximately 7:30 a.m. to go to McDonald’s restaurant. When he returned at around 8:30 a.m., Janice was gone. When he was unable to find her, he suspected that the dumpster may have been emptied during his absence. On October 3rd, video surveillance of the area confirmed that the dumpster had been picked up at 8:22 a.m. on October 1st. It also showed the departure of Janice's boyfriend, but no one else entering or leaving the dumpster. Tattoo: Right Wrist, A rose with text "KIRA"
Right Forearm, Cross with text "RIP DAVE B BOY 79-07"

Case reference: 2020007336.CaseDesc: On December 16, 1970, Abraham Wolfson was seen for the last time leaving a law office in Toronto, Ontario. Abraham had left with certificates worth $50,000 and had come into the city to arrange the sale of a property. Despite the offer of a reward from Abraham’s family, there has been no information pertaining to his whereabouts.

Case reference: 2006021799.CaseDesc: Leo Payash, was last seen on July 01, 1957. He and his mother Cecilia Payash, were walking on Red Lake Road in Ontario, and neither has been seen since.

Deformity: Nose, Described as having a "hooked" nose

Case reference: 2014002921.CaseDesc: Alban Robichaud has been missing since May 30, 1991 from Saint John, New Brunswick. Alban was employed with City Laundry and left his place of work at 3pm the day he went missing. Alban was seen in various uptown Saint John pubs and was last seen at Gene's Country Palace between 11:00 & 11:30 pm.

Case reference: 2024016877.CaseDesc: Nakita Harris, also known by her middle name "Jade," was last seen on October 2, 2023, in Regina, Saskatchewan. Her family and friends have not heard from her since November 2023. There is no evidence to suggest Nakita is the victim of foul play, however, the authorities and her family want to locate her to ensure her safety.

Case reference: 2005001599.CaseDesc: Shawn Jones and Leslie Jones were last seen together between October 26- 28, 1993, at the Tim Hortons in Owen Sound, Ontario.  Shawn was seen on Berford Street in front of the Pacific Hotel and Leslie was seen on 9th East Street in front of the Tim Hortons.
